name: Bezumny Shutnik
source:
The protagonist loves to joke around, loves to kill, is completely out of his mind, and does whatever he pleases. Play as this maniac and hunt for survivors. Find out whether the Joker gets to make himself a God in this camp or if he was deceived all along. He also has his own lovers with whom he will walk this fun and crazy path to the top.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1958272764]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角爱开玩笑，爱杀人，完全失去理智，为所欲为。扮演这个疯子并寻找幸存者。看看小丑是否能在这个营地中让自己成为上帝，或者他是否一直被欺骗。他也有自己的恋人，他将和他们一起走这条有趣而疯狂的巅峰之路。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1958272764]Steam[/url]]
